pages.text: $(item)Mesmerize$()$(br)Only the rare forms hold your gaze, and gold gives no protection. Within 24 blocks, looking near one slowly turns your view toward it. Look straight at it to break free.$(br2)One moth holds you at a time. A rare moth specimen mounted in a frame does the same.
